purpose: Independent source-family measurement cross-check for Afghanistan violence. This contract is not a replacement latent truth source and may not be used to tune Pineland.

source.publisher: University of Colorado Institute of Behavioral Science replication site

target_surface.construct: reported Taliban/Taleban versus Afghan-state-or-coalition armed violence

mapping_frozen_before_rows.state_or_coalition_regex: (?i)(afghanistan armed forces|forces of afghanistan|government of afghanistan|security of afghanistan|afghan national army|\bana\b|police|international security assistance force|\bisaf\b|\bnato\b|coalition|united states|u\.?s\.? forces)
mapping_frozen_before_rows.positive_cell_rule: At least one actor/ally field matches insurgent_regex and at least one actor/ally field matches state_or_coalition_regex. Multiple events in one province-week collapse to one positive incidence cell.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.negative_cell_rule: Source-silent province-weeks are retained as source-silent cells for predictive source-family scoring, but are NOT interpreted as known latent negatives for measurement-operator sensitivity or false-positive estimation.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.spatial_rule: Point coordinates are assigned by point-in-polygon to the existing Afghanistan analysis province geometry. Boundary/unmapped points are retained as unmapped and never silently nearest-neighbor imputed.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.date_rule: EVENT_DATE is parsed as the event date; invalid or ambiguous dates are retained as rejected rows, not imputed.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.actor_ambiguity_rule: Rows failing the frozen lexical actor mapping are excluded from the primary construct even if other ACLED aggregate category flags imply insurgent, local, or foreign involvement.

allowed_claims: independent source-family predictive score on the frozen ACLED mapping
forbidden_claims: ACLED source silence is true absence
agreement with ACLED proves absence of Afghanistan overfitting
ACLED fit licenses tuning of latent or recording parameters
